237:t_131:0.en:
$$刹那$$
(Why now...? Why are thoughts of my mother welling up from the depths of my heart...)

237:t_131:1.en:
$$刹那$$
(Is this their doing...? Are they trying to rob me of my will to fight...)

237:t_132:1.en:
$$ロックオン$$
(Damn it...! The feelings I threw away keep coming back, one after another! Are you telling me this is their power too!?)

237:t_133:0.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
(I... live by taking the lives of my own comrades... Do I even have the right to live...)

237:t_133:1.en:
$$ハレルヤ$$
(Yapping on about stuff nobody asked for...! What are you, a prisoner confessing his sins!?)

237:t_133:3.en:
$$ハレルヤ$$
(We've been fighting to live! If you've got time for pointless regrets, fight!)

237:t_133:4.en:
$$ハレルヤ$$
(You don't need to hold back against scum who try to peek into people's hearts!!)

237:t_134:0.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(What is this feeling...? Something is coming from somewhere apart from my own emotions... Fear is welling up...!)

237:t_134:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(That fear of the fundamental calamity... Could it be engraved in our genes...!?)

237:t_135:0.en:
$$グラハム$$
(The past I thought I had shaken off... It comes back to my heart once more!)

237:t_135:1.en:
$$グラハム$$
(Those things...! Are they specters that creep into my heart!?)

237:t_136:0.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Damn it... damn it! Why won't the bad thoughts go away since a while ago!」

237:t_136:1.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Colonel! I'll fight like I'm ready to die so I can see you again, Colonel!!」

237:t_136:2.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「So please! Give me just a little courage!!」

237:t_137:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
(I can tell... Those things are drawing out the fear and sorrow inside us and trying to make us submit to it...)

237:t_137:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
(...$$誰か$$ is lending me their strength... But who is it...)

237:t_137:2.en:
$$アマタ$$
(Gentle, big, and nostalgic... This powerful presence wrapping around me is...)

237:t_138:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
(Ever since we came to this space, my $$スフィア$$ has been reacting to something...)

237:t_138:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
(What is this space...? What is about to happen to the $$スフィア$$?)

237:t_139:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「If you're afraid, fall back. People who can't fight...」

237:t_139:4.en:
$n
「I will overcome the fear inside me...! I have until now... and I will from now on...!」

237:t_139:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
(The more despair grows, the more hope grows too... So these twins who fight each other aren't just for show...)

242:t_1:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「...I see. So you joined up with the $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ at the center of the galaxy...」

242:t_1:5.en:
$$甲児$$
「Looks like you've been through a lot too, just like us.」

242:t_1:6.en:
$$渓$$
「You guys got jumped together, so I get why you'd end up in a similar place, but...」

242:t_1:7.en:
$$渓$$
「We were in the middle of repairing the $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ and the $$真ゲッター$$ when it just happened out of nowhere.」

242:t_1:8.en:
$$凱$$
「If we hadn't run into $$グーラ$$ after the transfer, we might have kept drifting through space like that.」

242:t_1:9.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$グーラ$$... You mean the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s son...?」

242:t_1:10.en:
$$正太郎$$
「That's right. I hear $$グーラ$$ had come to the center of the galaxy to investigate the $$ゲッター線$$ and $$バアル$$.」

242:t_1:11.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「The $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ who bound him is gone now. After he guided $$號$$ and the others, he cooperated with us and fought $$バアル$$.」

242:t_1:12.en:
$$正太郎$$
「After the fighting ended, though, he went away.」

242:t_1:13.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$グーラ$$ isn't the only one we reunited with at the center of the galaxy. In the middle of fighting the $$宇宙怪獣$$, we ran into the $$ミケーネ神$$s again.」

242:t_1:14.en:
$$アルト$$
「So they're survivors of the ones we fought in the $$時獄戦役$$.」

242:t_1:15.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But meeting things like that again isn't anything to be happy about.」

242:t_1:16.en:
$$甲児$$
「Not necessarily. Fighting them, we got to see $$ゼウス神#pilot$$ again.」

242:t_1:17.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The god of light who lent us his strength?」

242:t_1:18.en:
$$甲児$$
「After the battle, $$ゼウス神#pilot$$ tried to send us to Earth, but we got interrupted and it failed...」

242:t_1:19.en:
$$渓$$
「Not that it makes up for it, but we met my old man... Dr. $$早乙女#getter$$.」

242:t_1:21.en:
$$アルト$$
「Possessed by the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s...」

242:t_1:22.en:
$$渓$$
「I don't get the reasoning either, but my old man had been freed from the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s.」

242:t_1:23.en:
$$渓$$
「We met my old man in some mysterious space we couldn't even place, and we heard him tell us about the collapse of the universe.」

242:t_1:25.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「And did you learn anything from that?」

242:t_1:26.en:
$$甲児$$
「According to the doctor, the collapse of the universe is caused by the clash between the force that seeks to vanish and the force that seeks to exist.」

242:t_1:27.en:
$$凱$$
「And that force that seeks to vanish creates $$バアル$$ to erase the life force that living things have.」

242:t_1:28.en:
$$凱$$
「Even if you survive the collapse that comes every 12,000 years, the true collapse of the universe hits once every 120 million years, they say.」

242:t_1:29.en:
$$アルト$$
「That's almost the same as what we heard in the $$プロトカルチャー$$ ruins...」

242:t_1:30.en:
$$凱$$
「...After that, thanks to the gracious guidance of the almighty $$ゲッター線$$, we got thrown into the hottest battle zone between the $$宇宙怪獣$$ and the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s.」

242:t_1:31.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That sounds kind of barbed.」

242:t_1:32.en:
$$甲児$$
「Of course it does! I don't know what the reason was, but try putting yourself in the shoes of the ones who got dragged around so casually.」

242:t_1:33.en:
$$渓$$
「With the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s in the picture too, you really can't let your guard down around the $$ゲッター線$$...」

242:t_1:34.en:
$$正太郎$$
「...And in the middle of that fight, we got caught up in a $$時空震動$$ and were transferred to the mysterious space where you all were sent as well.」

242:t_1:35.en:
$$バナージ$$
「So the rest is pretty much the same, then.」

242:t_1:36.en:
$$甲児$$
「Still, to think the fundamental calamity and the $$サイデリアル$$ were connected...」

242:t_1:37.en:
$$アルト$$
「Yeah... That force may be their trump card.」

242:t_1:38.en:
$$渓$$
「An enemy that overwhelms us with sheer power and damages even our hearts...」

242:t_1:39.en:
$$アルト$$
「The terror when I laid eyes on that thing was on a different level from every enemy we've fought so far.」

242:t_1:40.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Terror welling up from the depths of your heart... Truly an enemy fundamental to humanity.」

242:t_1:41.en:
$$アルト$$
「But we'll do this... $n has overcome fear too and fought all the way to today, after all.」

242:t_1:42.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Come to think of it, what about $n...?」

242:t_1:43.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...He's still unconscious even after we rejoined. It must be because of the $$血塗られた眼$$ that appeared in that mysterious space.」

242:t_1:45.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$アルト$$... Isn't it about time $n woke up?」

242:t_1:46.en:
$$アルト$$
「We can't just leave him be. Let's go check on him.」

242:t_1:52.en:
$$ハサン$$
「He woke up a good while ago.」

242:t_1:53.en:
$n
「What's the matter, you guys? All of you together...」

242:t_1:54.en:
$$アルト$$
「What are you talking about! We came because we were worried about you!」

242:t_1:55.en:
$$アマタ$$
「It's true! We heard you suddenly collapsed...!」

242:t_1:56.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Was it the influence of the $$血塗られた眼$$ after all?」
